en.summary: The commit adds extra backpressure headroom in a cache bank by asserting almost-full one slot earlier in the miss-reservation and DRAM-request queues, mitigating a real deadlock under miss pressure.
why_it_counts: The functional edit is in cache-bank DUT RTL and directly changes queue admission behavior
The patch alters backpressure timing to avoid a deadlock condition rather than changing debug output or tests
A follow-up commit later replaces this workaround with a more explicit MSHR scheduling fix, which reinforces that this patch was addressing a real bank deadlock
disqualifiers: This commit is a workaround rather than the final root-cause repair
It also contains unrelated debug and formatting edits outside the bank data path
evidence: hw/rtl/cache/VX_bank.v changes miss_resrv ALM_FULL from MSHR_SIZE-1 to MSHR_SIZE-2
The same file changes dram_req_queue ALM_FULL from DREQ_SIZE-1 to DREQ_SIZE-2

The later commit 0e1650e1c2ca62886a530bbb61db7ba184fccf49 restores both thresholds while adding explicit MSHR scheduling control, showing this earlier patch was a headroom workaround for the same deadlock

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A banked cache often needs a small amount of queue headroom to absorb bookkeeping and writeback traffic that arrives after a miss has already been admitted. If almost-full is asserted too late, the bank can keep accepting work until two tightly coupled queues become saturated at the same time, leaving no room for the transactions required to make progress and creating a deadlock or very long stall.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: almost-full backpressure margin in coupled miss queues
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The bank is under sustained miss pressure while replay, miss-reservation, and downstream memory-request queues all approach capacity
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Relax the almost-full threshold so the bank continues accepting requests until the miss-reservation or outbound request queue is one slot closer to full
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: delay backpressure by shrinking reserved queue headroom
portability_notes: Apply this to any cache bank that has at least one miss-tracking structure and one downstream request queue whose occupancy jointly determines forward progress
The key is not the exact queue names but the coupling between admission control and the ability to allocate follow-on miss traffic
If the DUT uses credits rather than ALM_FULL, reduce the reserved credits by one
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the queue fullness threshold that prevents new core requests from entering when miss-tracking or memory-request resources are nearly exhausted
Change that threshold so the queue reports almost-full one entry later than the fixed version
If two queues are jointly protecting progress, relax both thresholds together to recreate the original hazard window
Do not change the queue storage size itself; only change when admission backpressure is asserted

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: cache bank miss_resrv and dram_req_queue almost-full thresholds
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix moves the miss-reservation and DRAM-request queues to assert ALM_FULL one slot earlier by changing -1 thresholds to -2 thresholds.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore miss_resrv ALM_FULL to MSHR_SIZE-1 and dram_req_queue ALM_FULL to DREQ_SIZE-1 in VX_bank.v.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Under heavy miss traffic, the bank admits work too aggressively, exhausts coupled queue resources, and can deadlock or stall for a long period before any queue drains.
evidence_for_injection: The only functional DUT edits in this commit are the two ALM_FULL threshold changes in VX_bank.v
Both thresholds protect structures directly involved in miss reservation and outbound DRAM traffic
A same-day follow-up later removes this threshold workaround and replaces it with explicit scheduling control for the same deadlock class
notes: This entry is still useful for injection because headroom bugs are portable across many cache implementations
The resulting injected bug is a progress bug under pressure, not necessarily an immediately visible data corruption

zh.summary: 该提交通过让 miss reservation 队列和 DRAM request 队列提前一拍进入 almost-full 状态，为 cache bank 留出额外余量，从而缓解高 miss 压力下的真实死锁问题。
why_it_counts: 功能性修改发生在 cache bank 的 DUT RTL 中，并且直接改变了队列准入行为
该补丁调整的是反压时机，用于规避死锁，而不是修改调试输出或测试
后续提交用更明确的 MSHR 调度控制替代了这个 workaround，反过来证明这里修复的是同一个真实 bank deadlock
disqualifiers: 该提交更像 workaround，而不是最终根因修复
补丁还夹带了 cache bank 之外的无关调试与格式化修改
evidence: hw/rtl/cache/VX_bank.v 把 miss_resrv 的 ALM_FULL 从 MSHR_SIZE-1 改成了 MSHR_SIZE-2
同一文件把 dram_req_queue 的 ALM_FULL 从 DREQ_SIZE-1 改成了 DREQ_SIZE-2
后续提交 0e1650e1c2ca62886a530bbb61db7ba184fccf49 在加入显式 MSHR 调度控制的同时又把这两个阈值恢复回去，说明本提交是针对同一死锁的余量型 workaround

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: banked cache 往往需要预留少量队列余量，用来吸收 miss 已经接收之后才会到来的 bookkeeping 或 writeback 流量。如果 almost-full 触发得太晚，bank 就会继续接收新工作，直到两个紧耦合队列同时被打满，结果是系统再也没有空间去发出“解锁前进”所需的后续事务，从而出现死锁或超长停顿。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 耦合 miss 队列上的 almost-full 反压余量
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: bank 在持续 miss 压力下运行，同时 replay、miss reservation 和下游 memory request 队列都逼近容量上限
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 放松 almost-full 阈值，让 bank 在 miss reservation 或发往内存的请求队列更接近满时仍继续接收请求
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 减小预留队列余量，延后反压触发
portability_notes: 适用于任何同时拥有 miss 跟踪结构和下游请求队列，并且两者容量共同决定前向进展的 cache bank
关键不在于具体队列名字，而在于准入控制与后续 miss 流量分配能力之间的耦合
如果 DUT 用 credit 而非 ALM_FULL，可把保留 credit 数减少 1 来复现
concrete_injection_steps: 找到负责在 miss 跟踪资源或 memory-request 资源即将耗尽时阻止新 core request 进入的队列阈值
把该阈值改成比修复后晚一格才报告 almost-full
如果有两个队列一起保护前向进展，应同时放松两处阈值以恢复原始危险窗口
不要改队列总容量，只改何时对准入施加反压

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: cache bank 中 miss_resrv 与 dram_req_queue 的 almost-full 阈值
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 miss reservation 队列和 DRAM request 队列的 ALM_FULL 都提前一格触发，即从 -1 改为 -2。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_bank.v 中把 miss_resrv 的 ALM_FULL 改回 MSHR_SIZE-1，把 dram_req_queue 的 ALM_FULL 改回 DREQ_SIZE-1。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在高 miss 流量下，bank 会过于激进地接收请求，最终耗尽耦合队列资源并死锁，或者出现极长时间停顿。
evidence_for_injection: 该提交在 DUT 中唯一真正有功能意义的修改，就是 VX_bank.v 里的两个 ALM_FULL 阈值变更
这两个阈值保护的正是 miss reservation 与向 DRAM 发起请求的关键结构
同日后续提交移除了这一阈值 workaround，并以更明确的调度控制修复同类死锁
notes: 该条目依然适合故障注入，因为“余量不足”是很多 cache 实现里都可移植的错误类型
注入后的主要表现是高压下前向进展丢失，不一定立刻体现为数据错误
